purpose: Machine-readable morning reconciliation receipt and fast-start manifest for MASTER_ROOT, LEARNING, BOOK and PROSE chats.
master_root_rules: MASTER_ROOT is a chat role over SYSTEM_MASTER product-root governance, not a fifth peer system.
MASTER_ROOT includes CORE state because CORE is the shared Foundation & Spine child, but does not silently take CORE, LEARNING, BOOK or PROSE canonical-writer authority.
Cross-lane execution is routed to the owning lane unless a current root-owned obligation explicitly authorizes the product-root mutation.
freshness_rules: The morning manifest is a cache and reconciliation receipt, not authority over later repository movement.
Every chat start re-fetches current main and every relevant live owner control head.
A head or state change after manifest generation is AUTHORITY_DELTA and is reconciled before work; the chat does not ask the user to rediscover the project.
anti_surprise_rules: Do not ask the user to explain System Master, its topology, repository, lane purpose, prior work or project setup when canonical lookup can resolve it.
Do not express surprise at repository movement; classify and reconcile the delta.
Do not restart sealed/completed work because a chat is new.
If durable authority still cannot resolve a decision, ask only the smallest exact human/author/private/native/external decision required.
authority_boundary: This manifest accelerates startup and records reconciliation. It does not transfer PASS, owner, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, blind, native, publication or production authority.
